fields.description: When ticked, each new case goes to the officer whose desk matches its category, area and provider. Untick to send every case to the officer(s) on the Unrouted desk for manual triage.
fields.label: Route Cases to Matching Officers

fields.description: When ticked, a web portal submitter who files a grievance similar to one of their own from the last 24 hours is asked whether it is a new grievance (the API answers 409 POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE until the request is sent again with confirm_new). Tick only once the web client handles that answer. Cases are flagged for officer review either way.
fields.label: Ask Before Filing a Similar Grievance
